name: Shodan InternetDB
summary: Free, keyless lookup of open ports, hostnames, CPEs, tags and known CVEs for a public IPv4 or IPv6 address.
description: InternetDB returns a compact JSON summary per IP from Shodan scans: open ports, reverse hostnames, detected software CPEs, tags and vulnerability IDs. It is updated weekly according to its landing page and has no authentication.

endpoints.summary: Ports, hostnames, CPEs, tags and vulns for one IP

coverage.geographic: Global public IPs observed by Shodan

agent_notes: One IP per request; there is no bulk or search endpoint. A /docs page (HTTP 200) describes the schema. Empty lists mean nothing observed, a 404 means the IP has no data.
caveats: Licensing and rate limits were not confirmed from the docs.
Update cadence comes from the provider's description, not measured.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key.
